answer_1.quote: Text-to-Speech (TTS) aims to convert written text into high-fidelity speech and serves as a critical component in human-computer interaction.

answer_2.quote: We assess the synthesized speech based on content consistency (Character Error Rate & Word Error Rate, CER/WER), Speaker Similarity (SS), and speech quality (UTMOS, ).

answer_4.quote: To address ASR limitations (e.g., insensitivity to prosodic/pause errors), we manually validate a subset of hallucination cases through human evaluation of speech-text alignment.
answer_4.guideline: We categorized hallucinations into five primary types: Mispronounced/Incorrect characters, Repetition/Deletion Errors, Mid-Generation Collapse, Content Divergence, Prosody Errors.
